hook.name: MemeowGuardHook
hook.description: Per-pool trading guard for memeow v4 launches with dynamic LP fees: anti-snipe window enforcing max-buy caps and optionally decaying snipe tax, surge fee on large buys, EWMA volatility surcharge. Auto-burns a configurable share of buy output to the dead address via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Also hosts trustless on-chain single-tick limit orders that fill atomically when the price crosses their tick.
